question: Does the v20 generator (--ops=v20) find EXTREME boards in families where the Phase 19 generator stalled?
cores: the Phase 19 seed files, unchanged (copied to seed_<family>.json)
hardware: this container, 4 cores; each wave = one family, its 4 runs (2 arms x 2 seeds) in parallel, so both arms share the same load
qualifying_board: search-level EXTREME targets (ta90_design.gd NEED.EXTREME, unchanged): distinct >= 4, decision steps >= 8, an endgame decision, coverage >= 0.60, late >= 0.75, solution >= 13, greedy shortcut <= 0.20, every listed mechanic matters; positions within the seed's max_positions, opening solve within max_solve_nodes
measures: best board: distinct, steps, shortcut, mechanic essentiality, positions
full A/B report on the best qualifying board per weak family and arm: Category A pass, TIME UP worst ms, similarity to the bank
meaningful_benefit: v20 yields at least one qualifying board that passes the full Category A and B report in at least 2 of the 3 weak families (PX2, SG4, AS2), in a family where the baseline yields none or fewer - judged on these runs only; thresholds are not changed after the results
new_boards_only_if: meaningful_benefit holds; then at most 4, each passing Category A and B, not a variant of an existing board
